scheme_name: IARI – Indian Agricultural Research Institute Startup Grants
overview: The Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI) offers various startup and entrepreneurship development programs through its Pusa Krishi Incubator, including Agripreneurship Development Programs on Spirulina cultivation, Smart Snacks with Millets, and Entrepreneurship Development in Biofertilizers and Microbial Solutions. These programs aim to foster agri-startups and innovation in sustainable agriculture through training, skill development, and exposure to commercial ventures.
objectives: Strengthen research excellence and enhance scientific capacity among young scientists
Equip researchers with knowledge and practical skills to develop competitive research proposals
Support early-career scientists in translating innovative ideas into fundable projects
Provide hands-on training in developing winning research proposals for national and international funding agencies
Foster agripreneurship through skill development programs in cultivation, processing, and value addition
Promote sustainable agriculture through training in Spirulina biomass, millet-based snacks, and biofertilizers
Broaden the reach of capacity-building initiatives to regional stations and campuses in Assam and Jharkhand
Encourage need-based, multidisciplinary, and globally relevant research for sustainable development
eligibility: Eligibility varies by program: For the Dual PhD program with WSU, applicants must be doctoral students enrolled during 2022-23 or 2023-24 academic sessions. For Agripreneurship Development Programs, eligibility is open to interested candidates seeking training in Spirulina cultivation, millet-based snacks, or biofertilizers. For Young Professional-I (YP-I) positions under DMRC-funded projects, candidates must have a B.Sc. in Horticulture, Agriculture, Botany, Forestry, or Life Sciences from a recognized university.
benefits: Participants gain practical skills in research proposal writing, access to expert guidance from retired scientists and research leaders, exposure to national and international funding opportunities, training in interdisciplinary and impact-oriented research, skill development in GIS mapping, technical reporting, and field surveys, certification upon completion, and enhanced employability in agri-tech and research sectors. Some programs offer stipends, fee waivers, and research grants (e.g., AU$35,000 tuition waiver and AU$4,000 annual research grant in the WSU dual PhD program).
financial_support: Financial support varies across programs: The IARI-WSU Dual PhD program offers a full tuition fee waiver of AU$35,000 and a pro-rata annual research grant of AU$4,000 for 18–24 months. Other programs like Agripreneurship Development and YP-I positions provide stipends (e.g., ₹30,000 consolidated per month for YP-I) but do not mention direct grant funding for startups. No specific grant amount or fund corpus for startup grants is mentioned in the evidence.
application_process: 1. Submit Expression of Interest (EoI) along with a research proposal to the Office of International Affairs, IARI, within 30 days of notification (for Dual PhD program). 2. For training programs like Agripreneurship Development, apply via announcements on the IARI website or through designated coordinators. 3. For contractual positions (e.g., YP-I, SRF, JRF), submit applications via email to the specified address with self-attested documents. 4. Attend walk-in interviews or online/offline selection processes as announced. 5. Selected candidates must submit original documents for verification before offer letter issuance.
required_documents: No Objection Certificate (if employed or pursuing PhD)
deadlines: Rolling basis for some training programs; specific deadlines apply (e.g., 30 days for Dual PhD program EoI submission, 14.07.2026 for YP-I interview).
implementing_agency: Indian Council of Agricultural Research - Indian Agricultural Research Institute (ICAR-IARI)
contact_details: Email: tkdutta@iari.res.in (for SRF positions), drajaitiwari@gmail.com (for YP-I positions), ashish.pathology@gmail.com (for JRF positions); Helpline: IARI Helpline Numbers for Farmers - Farmer WhatsApp Helpline: 9560297502, Pusa Helpline: 011-25841670 / 25841039
caveats: Financial support in the Dual PhD program is not guaranteed; stipends or fellowships are endeavored but not assured
Students must cover visa, travel, medical insurance, and living costs in Australia for the WSU Dual PhD program
Withdrawal from the Dual PhD program after Stage 1 is considered irrevocable
Contractual positions (SRF, JRF, YP-I, Project Assistant-I) are temporary and co-terminus with the project
Age relaxations apply as per GoI/ICAR rules for reserved categories
No TA/DA is provided for attending interviews or joining contractual positions
